purpose: Prevent overclaim from v8.5.9/v8.6. The explicit smooth-C4 witness family has exponentially many exact extension types along the supplied Hamiltonian prefix order, but it also admits an explicit constant-width alternate path decomposition. Therefore the exponential prefix-state barrier is genuinely order-specific and is not a graph-global treewidth/pathwidth lower bound.

source_family.graph: Use the same G_m as v8.5.9/v8.6: V={(r,i): r in Z_4, 0<=i<m}; supplied Hamiltonian order consists of four consecutive rows; each column i has complementary C4_i.
source_family.parameter: m>=3 (the decomposition itself does not require m odd)

path_decomposition.bags: For i=0,...,m-2 let B_i = C_0 union C_i union C_{i+1}.
path_decomposition.bag_sizes: B_0 has 8 vertices; every later bag has at most 12 vertices. Hence width=max_i |B_i|-1 <=11.
edge_coverage: Every horizontal Hamiltonian edge (r,i)-(r,i+1) is contained in B_i.
Every complementary C4 edge lies inside one column C_j and therefore appears in a bag containing C_j.
All four row-connector/wrap Hamiltonian edges between C_{m-1} and C_0 are contained in B_{m-2}, which contains both columns.
running_intersection: Every vertex of C_0 occurs in every bag, so its bag-index set is an interval.
For 1<=j<=m-2, every vertex of C_j occurs exactly in B_{j-1} and B_j, two consecutive bags.
Every vertex of C_{m-1} occurs only in B_{m-2}.
path_decomposition.theorem: The displayed bags form a valid path decomposition of G_m of width at most 11 for every m>=3. Consequently pathwidth(G_m)<=11 and treewidth(G_m)<=11.

positive_control: The v8.6 witness family itself is not evidence that all smooth-C4 source graphs have large global decomposition width.

A standard exact 3-colouring dynamic program on this explicit path decomposition uses only a constant-size bag state space (at most 3^12 raw colour assignments per bag before local pruning), so this particular G_m family is polynomial-time solvable by the alternate decomposition even though the supplied-Hamiltonian prefix order has 2^(n/4-1) extension types.
Any future lower-bound claim must therefore quantify over decompositions/orders or use a source family whose relevant global width is provably unbounded; one bad order is insufficient.
algorithmic_consequence.firewall: This is a positive control for one explicit witness family, not a polynomial algorithm for the full Fleischner-Sabidussi hard source, not a proof that all smooth C4 graphs have bounded width, and not a statement about P versus NP.

exact_controls.checker_scope: For m in {3,5,7,11,25}, build G_m and the bags exactly; verify graph simplicity and degree 4, complete vertex coverage, every graph edge covered by at least one bag, the running-intersection property for every vertex, and maximum bag size <=12.

next_target.directive: Move away from the easy witness G_m. Audit the actual smooth fixed-C4 NP-hard source geometry for alternate decompositions. Seek either (a) an explicit source-realizable smooth C4 family with provably growing treewidth/branchwidth and then test whether the v8.6 extension-type construction survives balanced separators, or (b) a structural decomposition theorem yielding a constructive polynomial route. Do not infer unbounded width merely from NP-hardness; produce an explicit family, minor/grid certificate, or exact decomposition argument. Preserve witness reconstruction and all P-vs-NP firewalls.
